items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I don't think I ever met him. But I went with Prestige.

ctx.x: Well, we went to New York in ‘56. It was a lot...that was later.
However, in one of the interviews I read on the Internet, you stated that when the
opportunity to came to do your first recording, George Wallington, the distinguished pianist from New York, offered to introduce you to Bob Weinstock from Prestige Records...
